kind: greedy replies generated by an attested H200 serving deployment (vLLM, BF16) of the abliterated Qwen3.8-27B, teacher-forced on CPU through a float64 forward and the XS18 / XS20 integer DeltaNet head lowerings (PR #124 code, unchanged); only the DeltaNet head computation is lowered; no proof built

commits.code_at_run: 98aff462386aec401d3fd7fe5fad053d1ecdd2c1 (branch head when the registered run started; served_e2e.py and run_served.sh unchanged since 497dabb); run files committed in fd14d587b26dd2bbfb020e3b5f7d77dc483019f6

served_model_as_reported_by_deployment_c.note: not independently hashed here; the serving weights were not read by this lane

serving_route.description: an attested H200 serving deployment (vLLM, BF16), reached through a local bridge that forwards messages and sampling fields only and returns text, finish_reason and usage counts (no token ids, no logprobs)
serving_route.requests_breakdown: template probe: 1 attestation + 1 chat (not measured); batch: 1 attestation + 30 chat
serving_route.wall_times_note: client wall times include the bridge, attested TLS and the network path; not GPU numbers

cpu_checkpoints.note: stock layers 0..16 and embedding byte-identical to abl (PR #68 runs/diff.json), then abl layers 17..63, abl final norm and lm_head; read into memory by HTTP range request, never written to disk

toolchain.long_double: x87 80-bit (scaled_head.py relies on it, x86-64 only)
toolchain.blas: OpenBLAS (numpy wheel), 6 threads for the dense float64 forward; head workers: 6 spawned processes, 1 BLAS thread each

hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC-Rome, 16 vCPU KVM VM (results.yaml key cpu-epyc-rome-kvm-16), shared with other lanes and loaded
hardware.gpu: none on the CPU side; replies generated on one H200 by the serving deployment
hardware.pinning: registered run through the big-memory lock and fp-heavy.sh, taskset -c 0-5; MemAvailable checked >= 10 GB before start

repeats: one deterministic CPU run, duplicate-path determinism check (REF#2, XS18#2 on q01, q02); serving: 3 repetitions per prompt, text compared
data_on_disk: scratch outside the repo: ckpt.npz (all paths' residual states, overwritten after every layer); no weight data in the repo
